review.posthog_relevance: Adds snapshot records and establishes a template-based question path for the Replay Vision observation detail, supporting visual regression and accessibility checks.
review.reason: The change adds snapshot entries for inline scan and summarize button variants, which are used for visual regression and accessibility checks. It also establishes the use of the template_question function, which avoids model calls for known prompts. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and implementation change.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit and adoption are not demonstrated; this is an implementation of a feature, not a measurement of its impact.
